claims: Jack Nicklaus holds the record for the most Masters tournament wins.
Jack Nicklaus secured six Green Jackets during his career.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters in 1963, 1965, 1966, 1972, 1975, 1986.
Tiger Woods is second with five Masters victories.
Tiger Woods won the Masters in 1997, 2001, 2002, 2005, 2019.
Arnold Palmer has four Masters wins.
Arnold Palmer won the Masters in 1958, 1960, 1962, 1964.
Jimmy Demaret has three Masters wins.
Sam Snead has three Masters wins.
Gary Player has three Masters wins.
Nick Faldo has three Masters wins.
Phil Mickelson has three Masters wins.
Jack Nicklaus (1965-1966), Nick Faldo (1989-1990), and Tiger Woods (2001-2002).
Jack Nicklaus is the oldest Masters winner, winning his sixth title at age 46 in 1986.
Tiger Woods is the youngest Masters winner, winning his first title at age 21 in 1997.
